units.source_text: 我呀，每天都去監獄給他送點什麼，不過從明天起，我再也不去了。」

en.t: Every day I go to the prison to bring him something or other, but from tomorrow on I will not go anymore.

units.source_text: 不知何故，我對女人的身世毫無興趣，

en.t: For some reason, I had no interest at all in the woman's life story,

units.source_text: 也不知道是她缺乏說話技巧，還是搞錯了說話的重點，

en.t: whether it was because she was poor at telling it, or because she had mistaken where the point of the story lay,

units.source_text: 總之，對我來說，她的話不過都是耳旁風。

en.t: in any case, to me, everything she said simply went in one ear and out the other.

units.source_text: 比起女人對自己身世千言萬語的傾訴，反而是這樣一句短短的喟嘆更能引起我的共鳴，

en.t: Compared with a woman's endless account of her own life, that one brief sigh would move me far more deeply,

units.source_text: 儘管一直期待，但詭異的是，卻從沒有從人世間的女性中聽到過這樣的喟嘆。

en.t: and though I had always hoped to hear it, strangely enough, I had never once heard such a sigh from any woman in this world.
